chapter: Changing styles, the road and nightlife
title: Audiences have grown lackadaisical; hard on young musicians
summary: People now stay home or attend only chosen concerts, which makes it hard for unknown young musicians to be recognised.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: It used to be that Sunday afternoon used to be a good time for sessions or --
But that seems to have gone by the boards, too.

Right, right. Well, people have become very lackadaisical about anything now. And if it don't be for certain concerts or certain things that they want to see, they're just not going to spend the time to go and speculate on anything. And this makes it bad for the upcoming musician, the young one who doesn't have the name. He can be ever so great, but it's so hard for him to get recognition.
There's just so much equipment available to have entertainment in the home.
Now you have the video recorders to record movies, and you can show movies.
